items.prompt: What constructs a matching upper bound?

options.why: Sorting exposes the order to process but does not itself assign or reuse any rooms.
Reuse a freed room when possible; open a new one only if all rooms are occupied, matching the peak-overlap lower bound.
Discarding a long session would fail the requirement to host every input session.
Equal ending times do not make sessions shareable; overlapping sessions still need separate rooms.

items.explanation: A new room is needed only when every previous room is busy.
